mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ARTICLE (ARTICLE_CODE, TITLE, WRITER_CODE, CONTENT, REGISTERED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_ARTICLE_CODE.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{writerCode}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT A.ARTICLE_CODE AS articleCode, A.WRITER_CODE AS writerCode, U.NAME AS writerName, A.TITLE AS title, A.CONTENT AS content, A.REGISTERED_AT AS registeredAt, A.VIEWS AS views FROM ARTICLE A INNER JOIN USERS U ON A.WRITER_CODE = U.USER_CODE WHERE A.ARTICLE_CODE = #{articleCode} AND A.STATUS = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "COMMENT" (COMMENT_CODE, WRITER_CODE, ARTICLE_CODE, PARENT_CODE, CONTENT, REGISTERED_AT, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_COMMENT_CODE.NEXTVAL, #{writerCode}, #{articleCode}, #{parentCode}, #{content}, #{registeredAt}, #{status})
